easyPrerequisites: You control another creature that has power or toughness 1 or less.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with power or toughness 1 or less
When the creature dies, Arnyn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
